title: Rename ObjectTable to ObjectGrid - Align with @objectstack/spec view.zod grid type
body:
## Rename object-table to object-grid - Complete ✅

All files have been updated to reflect the rename from ObjectTable to ObjectGrid:

### Schema & Types ✅
- `ObjectTableSchema` → `ObjectGridSchema`
- Type: `'object-table'` → `'object-grid'`
- Removed `viewType` field (fixed to grid)
- Removed kanban/calendar/gantt configs
- **Added missing `title` and `description` legacy fields for backward compatibility**

### Component ✅  
- `ObjectTable.tsx` → `ObjectGrid.tsx`
- Component: `ObjectTable` → `ObjectGrid`
- Props: `ObjectTableProps` → `ObjectGridProps`
- Updated `ObjectView` and exports
- **Fixed fetchData dependency array**
- **Updated error messages to use "grid" instead of "table"**

### Tests ✅
- `ObjectTable.test.tsx` → `ObjectGrid.test.tsx`
- `ObjectTable.viewzod.test.tsx` → `ObjectGrid.viewzod.test.tsx`
- All references updated

### Documentation ✅
- `object-table.mdx` → `object-grid.mdx`
- `object-table-migration.mdx` → `object-grid-migration.mdx`
- Updated titles, descriptions, and all content
- Clarified that ObjectGrid implements the grid view type from ListView
- **Fixed meta.json navigation to reference object-grid**

### Fumadocs Integration ✅
- **Created `ObjectGrid.component.yml` metadata file**
- **Removed old `ObjectTable.component.yml`**
- **Fixed meta.json to properly route to object-grid documentation**
- Includes enhanced props for view.zod alignment
- Demo-ready configuration

### Code Review Fixes ✅
- Added `title` and `description` to legacy fields (backward compatibility)
- Fixed `fetchData` useCallback dependency array
- Updated error/loading messages to reference "grid"

### Implementation Notes:
- ObjectGrid implements the **grid view type** from @objectstack/spec ListView schema
- Future view types (kanban, calendar, gantt) will be separate components (ObjectKanban, ObjectCalendar, ObjectGantt)
- Full backward compatibility maintained through legacy field support
- All type exports and component registry updated
- Fumadocs metadata ready for documentation generation
- Documentation properly routed in fumadocs navigation

This addresses all user feedback and code review comments.
